cohort: 439 extremely preterm infants (EPIs) admitted to the Department of Neonatology of the Third Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University from 2011 to 2020
finding: After adjusting for confounding factors, male EPIs, particularly those with a birth weight between 750 and 999 grams, were found to have a significantly higher risk of respiratory complications compared to females.
birth_weight: Varied, with specific analysis on 750-999 grams
